flags: The cached sources do not establish the complete US 50 branch from Lawrenceburg or a Clarksville endpoint. The overview follows the supported New Albany–Paoli–Shoals–Vincennes journey; the Y-shaped full corridor claim was dropped.

Paoli’s Quaker, Underground Railroad and forest history is available only in the cached Wikipedia account; no community, forest-manager or archival source is supplied. No forest access claim is made.
Jug Rock’s 42-foot height and stopper description are explicitly attributed to the 1871 report, not presented as a fresh measurement.
